data.one_liner: Android Picture-in-Picture mode plugin with callbacks, widgets and actions
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to check if Picture-in-Picture (PiP) is available, enter PiP mode programmatically, handle mode change callbacks, and build PiP-dependent layouts using a specialized widget with media action presets.
use_when: You need to support Android Picture-in-Picture mode for video playback or continuous tasks
You want to display different UI layouts depending on whether PiP mode is active
avoid_when: You are building for iOS, web, or desktop platforms (Android only)
You do not need native PiP capabilities
strengths: Easy activity wrapper for enabling callbacks
Includes ready-to-use PiP actions and layouts for media playback
Provides a dedicated PipWidget for switching UI trees based on PiP state
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and modifying the main activity
data.setup_notes: Add android:supportsPictureInPicture="true" to the activity in AndroidManifest.xml and inherit from PipCallbackHelperActivityWrapper in Kotlin or Java.
